name: table-column-add
description: A split table frame with a separate column-add marker.
useCase: Add a table column with a direction-specific text label.
misuse: This generic add-column glyph does not specify left or right.

16.reason: The shared table frame leaves a deliberate lower-right opening for the add mark; column and row variants transpose the same geometry. Text master: 1.5px construction. The complete silhouette is centered within the shared 12 × 12 drawing area.

24.reason: The shared table frame leaves a deliberate lower-right opening for the add mark; column and row variants transpose the same geometry. Interface master: 1.75px construction. The complete silhouette is centered within the shared 18 × 18 drawing area.
